rationale.consistency: Command wiring follows existing cobra/opts patterns, but a non-_test file imports testing/httpmock, an unexported error type has exported fields, and IsEnterprise is a needless wrapper over ghauth.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers symlink/hardlink dupes, empty/dir/size limits, alt-on-video, reference defs and code spans; but partial-upload success still posts the body, contradicting 'if one upload fails nothing is written'.
rationale.scope: Delivers all six commands and the package, but adds dead code (isSingleImage, UploadStub), an always-true KeepExistingBody option, and unrequested partial-upload semantics.
rationale.readability: references.go is a 550-line hand-rolled byte scanner with deep nesting and little commentary; client.go repeats near-identical uploadError literals a dozen times.
rationale.robustness: Resources closed and status codes handled, but partial uploads write content anyway, pr edit silently drops a user --body when uploads fail, and fullEnd can stay 0 producing bad splices.
rationale.maintainability: findLinkDetails reimplements CommonMark parsing beside goldmark, NewUploader is built twice in pr create, the deferred-flag list is duplicated in issue edit, and error construction is copy-pasted.
